_comment: EP03 release cut (25 Nov 2026 brief, for 6 PM IST): title వేములవాడ రాజన్న from frame one over the bull and the tether; the tying gesture plays to its end; the hunt and the riverbank get their own pictures; the legend is marked స్థలపురాణం on screen. R01 (tether), R07c (riverbank) and R09 (three handfuls) are the quoted new shots.

assets.R01: Hands knot the bull's rope to a square-cut stone post, pull it tight and let go; the bull stands beside it.
assets.S02: Bull hooves beside devotees' feet; a family walks holding the rope.
assets.S03: The Vemulawada temple front with families and their bulls.
assets.S04: A family and their bull walk clockwise along the shrine wall.
assets.S05: Ink sketch: two stone uprights at the east gate, a calf tied to one.
assets.S06: The Dharmagundam beside the temple (illustration, marked ప్రతీకాత్మక చిత్రం).
assets.S07: King Narendra draws his bow on a hunt.
assets.R07c: The rishi fills his pot at the stream; the pot slips from his hands into the water.
assets.S07b: The pot floats in the stream; the king stands in the water.
assets.S08: The king walks a long road through the hills.
assets.S09: The king's hands in the tank water.
assets.R09: The king's hands scoop water from the tank three times.
assets.S10: Night by the tank: the king asleep, a glow under the water.
assets.S11: The king waist-deep in the tank holding the glowing find.
assets.S11b: The king kneels before a small lamp-lit shrine on the bank.

segments.sees: Close on a family with their bull, the vow.
The rope is knotted to the post and released (the offering is tied).
Close on the calf tied at the pillar.
Second handful: hands dip and lift.

segments.flag: third scoop is the second scoop mirrored; a true three-scoop retake is 7.5 credits

segments.sees: The king asleep by the tank.
The glow at the bottom of the tank.

lines: మీ ఇంట్లో ఎవరైనా రాజన్నకి కోడె మొక్కు తీర్చారా?
ఆ రోజు మీకు గుర్తున్నది ఏంటో చెప్పండి.
